definition.title: A Vigil for the Fallen
definition.briefing: Mara guards the burial gate until the mourners leave. Keep Gravecallers behind the Boneguards, where fresh mortal corpses can be raised. Hold the Necropolis for sixty-five seconds with at most one replacement soldier.
definition.successText: The mourners leave safely. Iven reports that the warband is removing names from the burial ledgers, and Mara follows its patrol.
definition.failureText: Mara or the Necropolis falls while the mourners remain inside. The vigil must begin again.

objectives.text: Hold the fortress for 65 seconds. The reinforcement allowance is 1; the listed waves are finite.
Keep Mara Ashkeeper alive during the defense.

definition.title: Names in the Watchbook
definition.briefing: Mara enters the patrol camp with Iven waiting outside. Recover the erased burial list from the eastern watchbook and return without two alarms. Move rather than attack through the high northern path.
definition.successText: The watchbook names the captive archivist. Mara chooses whether to escort the archivist out or break the guard formation at the burial bridge.
definition.failureText: The patrol catches Mara or raises a second alarm. The watchbook raid must begin again.

objectives.text: Reach the marked archive at (30, 6) without two alarms.

definition.title: The Burial Bridge
definition.briefing: Mara frees the burial bridge instead of following the archivist. Kill the two wounded gate guards near the Ossuary and have the Gravecaller raise their real corpses. Destroy the marked crossbow captain. The first corpses are close enough to use immediately.
definition.successText: Raised guards turn on the captain and open the bridge. Mara follows the recovered names into the Ash Judge's court.
definition.failureText: Mara falls before the bridge captain is defeated. Reset and raise the fresh gate-guard corpses before they expire.

objectives.text: Raise at least one fresh corpse and defeat the marked bridge captain.
Keep Mara Ashkeeper alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.

definition.title: The Ash Judge
definition.briefing: The Ash Judge guards the erased names. His wounded guards leave corpses. Move the Gravecaller close enough to raise them and screen the Gravebows with those ranks. Mara can drain hostile guards. Leave the judgment circles or interrupt the Judge's sentence.
definition.successText: The Judge falls and the names return to the ledgers. Mara ends the march at the burial gate, with Iven recording every soldier who did not return.
definition.failureText: Mara falls before the names are restored. The Ash Judge keeps the court.

objectives.text: Defeat Ash Judge. Survive all three phases and move out of a warning circle or interrupt it with concentrated fire.
Dodge or interrupt at least one telegraphed attack.
